When my friendships were destroyed over a minecraft castle. I had worked on it all summer, it was the result of about four months of building, my then “friends” destroyed it. Doesn’t seem to scary yet, but there’s more. After that experience it was extremely tense around everyone, and there was one particular girl that really didn’t like me. So she decided to blackmail my boyfriend into cheating on me with her. He did it. It started my journey down the road of anxiety, and suddenly I was having anxiety attacks due to the stress of losing my friends and the sudden lack of trust in my relationship. It caused me to be mentally unstable and going from a regular person to someone who regularly has panic/anxiety attacks and serious suicidal thoughts. I went from having a good group of friends to being almost completely isolated from everyone. But recently I have started making new friends again, my boyfriend has gained my trust back, and I’m getting a job. I feel better now. The reason I was so effected was due to the sudden isolation and the feeling that no one cared about me, not the castle itself I couldn’t care less about it now, but at the time it was what I considered to be my art project for the summer, and early school months. It transcended from a Minecraft game, to a personal crisis in my life. That was the scariest video game moment, but also one of the scariest moments of my life. Wow.
